_doc: Graphics budget for the AAA-graphics work. 'baseline' = measured on the sandbox (4-core, SwiftShader, headless Chromium) before any graphics change: tools/perf.mjs (640x360, High, 3 ships x 2 spots + crowd rows) and tools/loadtime.mjs (960x540, seed 11 ship 0). Software GL: only compare against numbers from the same box. 'limits' are what tools/gfx-gate.mjs enforces. NOTE: the sandbox baseline already exceeds the two time limits (titleLoadS, beginToEnterS were set for a faster box); run the gate with GFX_TIME_SCALE=1.3 (or higher) on a slow box, or judge time limits relative to baseline.
